whatsNew: Lightweight init gate — branded splash screen on cold open while detectors and pattern analysis complete. Fades away automatically. Not shown on tab resume.
fixes: PPH Pin — _pinPPHPattern was writing to wrong localStorage key CB_PINNED_EVENTS instead of clinbridge_pinned_events. Pin appeared to save but never showed in Pinned Events. Fixed: now calls pinEvent() with correct schema; falls back to direct write with correct key.

PPH population-average guard removed from Sentinel section and nudge rule — with 89 meal pairs the 6 qualifying PPH events (avg 22.8 mmHg drop) were diluted to 2.7 mmHg avg, failing the guard. Three confirmed qualifying events is the only threshold needed.

PPH Sentinel section re-implemented as standalone function _buildSentinelPPHSection() — eliminates IIFE nesting risk. Section appears at bottom of Sentinel when 3+ PPH events confirmed in last 30 days with avg drop guard met.
PPH Sentinel section re-added as standalone function _buildSentinelPPHSection() — eliminates IIFE bracket nesting that caused the v9.10.81 syntax error and broke all buttons

PPH guard fix — settings.features.meals is only set by wizard; never true for users who track meals by default. Both the Sentinel PPH section and nudge rule now gate on actual meal log count instead of the feature flag.

PPH Pattern — dedicated Sentinel section always shown when 3+ events confirmed: event count, avg drop, recent events list, doctor language, Pin button closes Sentinel into Pinned Events. Duplicate-pin guard included.

pph_pattern_detected nudge moved from position 21 to position 2 in NUDGE_RULES so it is no longer blocked by behavioral nudges firing first. btnFn corrected from broken openAdvancedAnalytics to openAnalyticsDashboard.

pph_pattern_detected Sentinel nudge never fired for any user — snapshotSetup() stored activeFeatures (array) but not features (object); nudge guard checked d.setup.features.meals which was always undefined. Fixed: snapshotSetup() now writes d.setup.features = features; guard updated with activeFeatures fallback for existing installs

Appointments card not showing on main page — four root causes fixed: refreshAllDisplays() now calls updateRecentAppointmentWidget(), iOS tab-resume path now calls loadAppointments(), deleteAppointment() now refreshes the main-page card, and empty-state shows an Add Appointment prompt instead of hiding the card entirely

Advanced Analytics collapsible panels — all 11 detail panels now start collapsed after Generate Analysis; new Panel Index card lists every panel with Expand buttons; Expand All / Collapse All controls; expanding auto-scrolls panel into view
getAllHistoricalData date-range filter restored — was bypassed with a testing flag that was never reverted, loading all data regardless of the 90-day window
37 DEBUG console.log statements removed from getAllHistoricalData
Breathing sessions now included in getAllHistoricalData (breathing key) and Ask ClinBridge context
Two Sentinel nudge rules added: breathing_try_it (first session encouragement) and breathing_declining_response (declining HR response alert)
